messages:
maria: quick check — planning to flip Gatekeeper for model-v7 in eu-west-1 at 09:15 UTC. targeting 5% traffic. guardrails: p99 latency < 300ms, errors < 0.5%, fallback -> model-v6. can ops confirm config? :eyes:

devin: ack. where's the rollout schedule? want automatic ramp or manual steps?

maria: manual ramp: 5 -> 20 -> 50 over 30m intervals. abort if any guardrail fails. added note: disable session affinity. dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/2187654321

ash: quick note — Gatekeeper enforces percent by weighted routing, not sticky sessions. if user-level stickiness needed we need cookies. for this rollout session_affinity=false is fine.

samar: I'm on infra. confirming the feature flag config is uploaded to feature-store. will run the flip at 09:15 UTC. pinging @leo for oncall coverage.

leo: oncall here — I'll monitor SLO dashboard and logs. set alerts to paging policy 'canary-violation' please.

devin: please add ramp schedule in the playbook and set auto-abort: abort_after=1 failure window=5m; threshold error_rate>0.5% or p99>300ms

maria: added to playbook. snippet I used: ```
featurectl set gatekeeper.model_v7 --enable --scope=region:eu-west-1 --percent=5 --session_affinity=false --fallback=model_v6
```

ash: note: include 'exclude_internal=true' so internal test traffic doesn't skew metrics. also add 'min_samples=200' for metric gating.

samar: done. feature config now: exclude_internal=true; min_samples=200; abort_policy=auto; ramp=[5,20,50]; interval=1800s

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: infra quota ok, GPUs available in eu-west-1, routing table patched.

maria: ok launching in 5. thanks all — will post follow-up at each step. :rocket:

leo: acknowledged. will escalate if spike. :rotating_light:

devin: quick code-review ping — PR 1234 updates the Gatekeeper telemetry tags; pls review when able @ash @maria

ash: on it, will review in next 15m.

maria: 09:20 UTC follow-up: at 5% no regressions so far. metrics: p99=210ms, error_rate=0.12%. proceeding to 20% in 5m.

samar: bumped to 20% at 09:25 UTC. monitoring.

maria: 09:35 UTC — at 20% p99=230ms, error_rate=0.15%. holding before 50% for another 10m.

leo: small spike in tail for one subregion, investigating logs. looks like transient GC on instance pool-3.

ash: noted, increasing tail tolerance to 320ms for 10m window to avoid flapping; will rollback if it persists.

maria: thanks — will keep holding. will open postmortem if we hit abort.
